english.title: Unship / unload a of drug of a temporary class with intent to evade a prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[unshipped drugs,]_
(B)_[landed drugs in a port,]_
(C)_[unloaded drugs from an aircraft,]_
(D)_[assisted in the unshipping of drugs,]_
(E)_[assisted in the landing of drugs at a port,]_
(F)_[assisted in the unloading of drugs from an aircraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..), which were subject to a temporary class drugs order and the importation of which was prohibited by the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, with intent to evade the prohibition
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(a), (4) and (5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Dadlwytho / gwagio / helpu i ddadlwytho / wagio cyffur o ddosbarth dros dro gan fwriadu osgoi gwaharddiad
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), bu ichi

(A)_[ddadlwytho cyffuriau,]_
(B)_[ddod â chyffuriau ar y tir mewn porthladd,]_
(C)_[ddadlwytho cyffuriau oddi ar awyren,]_
(D)_[helpu i ddadlwytho cyffuriau oddi ar long,]_
(E)_[helpu i ddod â chyffuriau ar y tir mewn porthladd,]_
(F)_[helpu i ddadlwytho cyffuriau oddi ar awyren,]_

sef **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..), a oedd yn destun gorchymyn dosbarth cyffuriau dros dro yr oedd mewnforio wedi'i wahardd drwy Ddeddf Camddefnyddio Cyffuriau 1971, gan fwriadu osgoi'r gwaharddiad
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 50(2)(a), (4) a (5) Deddf Rheoli Tollau Tramor a Chartref 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
